exposure: Physician performance (decision making and procedural skill)
cohort: The study implicitly involves physicians and their patients, as it examines physician performance and its impact on birth outcomes using administrative data.
finding: Poor diagnosticians can be identified using administrative data, and improving physician decision-making enhances birth outcomes by reallocating C-sections to align with patient risk levels.
mod_finding: Improved decision-making improves birth outcomes by reducing C-section rates for low-risk cases and increasing them for high-risk cases.
